message: 弱い貴女は美しい

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder if Azel is having fun?」

name: Paqy
message: 「...Shouldn't that be 'I wonder if he's actually doing his job?'」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe so, but... you know」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, our mysterious transfer student doesn't exactly know how to have fun, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「Exactly」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel, Azel...」

name: Paqy
message: 「...There he is」
Away from the crowd, Azel stood holding his camera aimed up at the sky.
Looking in the direction the camera was pointed, a red balloon was floating against the blue sky.
I thought he was going to take a picture, but.
Azel just kept his finger resting on the button.
Before he took the shot, the balloon drifted higher and higher into the air.

name: Synn
message: 「What's wrong?」
I ran over to Azel.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!」

name: Azel
message: 「...Oh, it's you」

name: Synn
message: 「How's it going?」

name: Synn
message: 「By the way, why didn't you take that picture just now?」

name: Azel
message: 「...What does it matter」
Azel turned his face away and began walking briskly.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, um」

name: Synn
message: 「About how many photos have you taken?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, it's totally fine if you don't feel like taking any. It's not like there's a quota or anything」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「It's stew packed full of farm-fresh potatoes!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Smells so good--! Looks delicious!」
Azel suddenly looked up.

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Oh, is that so! Well then, I'll throw in a little extra for you」
Following his gaze, Shinaoba had a broad smile on her face as she handed Sacchin a bowl brimming with stew.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Whoa. What am I gonna do with this much--」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well, there's always room for dessert, so it'll be fine--」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「If you like it, be sure to become a regular of ours」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Always thinking about business, huh--」
It was just an ordinary exchange, yet Azel pointed his camera at the two of them.
However, his finger resting on the shutter button hesitated for some reason.
While he hesitated, Shinaoba started attending to another student.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Mmm, so good, so good」
Just watching her eat made it look delicious.
Once again, Azel aimed his camera, his finger resting on the button.
I thought he'd actually take the shot this time, but...
His finger on the button kept hesitating.

name: Sacchin
message: 「That was delicious--」
Sacchin ended up finishing the stew.

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Of course it was! My husband's eye for ingredients is nothing to sneeze at, you know」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You're totally right--, I'll spread the word to my friends too--」
Without taking a single picture, Azel turned on his heel and started walking away.
Oh, so that's what it is.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Azel」

name: Synn
message: 「Just because this is a Student Council activity doesn't mean what you take pictures of is set in stone. You can photograph whatever you want」

name: Synn
message: 「Even a seemingly ordinary scene is totally fine」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry for not telling you beforehand」

name: Azel
message: 「...Why are you apologizing」

name: Synn
message: 「You're thinking you have to take photos that look strictly like official records, right, Azel?」

name: Synn
message: 「...Huh, no?」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be... you already took a ton of pictures and you're worried about running out of shots?」

name: Synn
message: 「In that case, there's a computer at headquarters, so you can save the image data you've taken so far there and start taking new ones」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry for not explaining enough」

name: Azel
message: 「...That's not it」

name: Synn
message: 「It isn't?」

name: Azel
message: 「...I haven't taken any」

name: Synn
message: 「Not even one?」
Azel hesitated for a moment, then gave a small nod.

name: Synn
message: 「But it's not like there weren't any sights you wanted to shoot, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「For now, don't worry about the number of shots or anything--just take pictures however you feel like」
Suddenly, Azel raised his face.
When I looked in the direction his gaze was turned--
Beyond the crowd stood a tall man dressed in a strangely eye-catching outfit.
He was looking at Azel too.
No, that wasn't it--he was looking at Azel and me.
For some reason, a strange, tingling sensation echoed at the core of my head.
The man narrowed his eyes for an instant, and a smile suddenly appeared on his lips. The strange sensation echoing inside my head vanished.
The man started walking toward us.
His gait was graceful; even though he was cutting straight through the sea of people, he didn't even make a show of dodging the crowd as he strode briskly closer.
A sense of intuition bordering on certainty surfaced in the back of my mind.
That sensation had already disappeared, yet I knew that person wasn't an ordinary human.
Just as I started to step forward to shield Azel--

name: Azel
message: 「No need」
A cold voice cut me off.
The man, who had made his way right in front of us before I knew it, let out a faint wry smile.

name: Man
message: 「Indeed」
Turning toward me, he spoke.

name: Man
message: 「How vexing. To think that I, a gentleman, would be mistaken for some sort of ruffian who runs wild without regard for the setting. Perhaps my training is still lacking」
I opened my hands, which I had clenched without realizing it. My palms were damp with sweat.
His eyes stopped on Azel's digital camera.

name: Man
message: 「Still, what brought about this change of heart?」

name: Man
message: 「To think that you, of all people, would seek to leave behind a record of this world」
For some reason, Azel averted her eyes.

name: Azel
message: 「...It's just a whim.」

name: Man
message: 「Hmm. A whim, is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... do you know him?」

name: Azel
message: 「Wha--」

name: Azel
message: 「Impossible!」

name: Man
message: 「I wonder about that? After all, we have just become acquainted like this.」

name: Man
message: 「From this moment on, that makes us acquaintances.」
What a pushy guy.

name: Azel
message: 「...Forget it.」

name: Man
message: 「While it is my motto to grant a beautiful woman's wishes to the best of my ability...」

name: Man
message: 「Regrettably, I pride myself on my memory when it comes to ladies.」
The man laughed with amusement,

name: Man
message: 「That the three of us should meet here must be fate. Would you mind taking a commemorative photo for us?」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh, well...」

name: Azel
message: 「I refuse.」

name: Man
message: 「That is terribly unfortunate.」
muttered the man, not sounding particularly sorry at all,

name: Man
message: 「Though your refusal is only natural. Because you already know.」
With a theatrical flourish, fluttering the trim on his cuffs and spreading his arms wide,

name: Man
message: 「That every sight before us is nothing more than a fleeting bubble, destined to vanish like an illusion.」

name: Man
message: 「You, that boy, myself, and all the people chatting so happily around us right now--every last one will fade into nothingness.」

name: Azel
message: 「That's...」
Sensing fear in her voice, I looked at Azel.

name: Man
message: 「At the very least, this current world will be lost. It can never be reclaimed」

name: Azel
message: 「But, that's...」

name: Man
message: 「Yes, you know it. You know it better than anyone」

name: Azel
message: 「...I know. But」
I didn't know why, but Azel was frightened. She was bewildered.

name: Man
message: 「Heh. This is unexpected」

name: Man
message: 「You are beautiful when bewildered. You are beautiful when troubled」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm not troubled or anything」

name: Man
message: 「You are beautiful when wavering」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm not wavering」

name: Man
message: 「Above all, you are beautiful when weak」

name: Azel
message: 「I am--」

name: Synn
message: 「Please stop!」
Before I knew it, I was standing in front of Azel.

name: Azel
message: 「I don't need you to protect me--」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel is scared. I can tell」

name: Azel
message: 「Th-That's not...」
I looked the man straight on.

name: Synn
message: 「I don't understand what you're saying at all. But Azel hates it. She's scared. So please stop」
His gaze locked onto me.

name: Man
message: 「How intriguing. That you, of all people, would shield her」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean」

name: Man
message: 「It wouldn't be very entertaining if you got the answer so easily, now would it」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't dodge the question!」

name: Man
message: 「You will understand. In the very near future, whether you want to or not. Because you two are the very ones at the center of this grand current--」

name: Shio
message: 「That's enough!」

name: Misa
message: 「Give it up already, you pickup artist!」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa! Shio-chan!」

name: Shio
message: 「Step away from Lady Azel and Sir Synn, and submit to capture quietly!」

name: Misa
message: 「Honestly, Sakura-kun is so unreliable! If you can't even properly protect a single girl, you're not cut out to be Student Council President.」

name: Man
message: 「Well, well, what a gallant and lovely Valkyrie. I fear I might be overcome by the sheer passion with which you pursue me.」

name: Shio
message: 「Speak not such nonsense. It is not out of fondness that I pursue you!」

name: Shio
message: 「When I see a scoundrel like you disrupting the order, my blood of justice boils!」

name: Man
message: 「To set a maiden's blood boiling so passionately... It seems I truly am a sinful man.」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... Misa. What's going on here?」

name: Misa
message: 「This pervert has been wandering around the venue all morning, hitting on girls indiscriminately like some kind of lecher!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that what happened?!」

name: Man
message: 「'Lecher' is quite hurtful. Calling out to a beautiful woman when one spots her is simply a gentleman's etiquette. It is the same nature as a honeybee drawn to the nectar of a flower.」

name: Shio
message: 「Ridiculous! To persistently pester someone who clearly dislikes it makes you nothing more than an insolent fool who knows no bounds!」

name: Man
message: 「I do not recall pestering anyone, however.」

name: Shio
message: 「Were you not just pestering Lady Azel right before our eyes?!」

name: Man
message: 「Ah, I see. So I happened to provoke your jealousy, is that it?」

name: Shio
message: 「If you do not submit to capture at once, I may have to subject you to a rather painful experience--is that acceptable to you?」

name: Man
message: 「Quite acceptable. Receiving a woman's passionate advances is also the destiny of a handsome man.」

name: Shio
message: 「Here I come!」
With a whoosh, her naginata flashes through the air. The man dodges effortlessly, barely seeming to move.

name: Man
message: 「I have certainly witnessed your passionate strike. However, to keep me tied down here, it seems you are still a little lacking in love.」

name: Shio
message: 「Why, you smart-mouthed--!」
With another whoosh, her naginata flashes once more. Yet the result remains the same.

name: Shio
message: 「Curse you, darting around like that」

name: Man
message: 「Irritating a lady excessively is not my intention.」
The man turned his gaze toward Azel and me.

name: Man
message: 「Since you've also treated me to a sight one rarely gets to see, I suppose it's about time I took my leave」
Saying so, he gave a bow.

name: Man
message: 「Farewell」
Just as a massive flurry of rose petals suddenly swirled wildly through the air, the man used them as cover and ran off.

name: Shio
message: 「Wait up!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, get back here!!」
Isn't he supposed to vanish into them instead......

name: Synn
message: 「Azel, are you okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!」

name: Azel
message: 「Tch...... Wh-What is it」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you okay?」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm fine」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm fine」

name: Synn
message: 「......Well, if you say so」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Azel」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you think that guy was trying to say?」

name: Synn
message: 「Didn't you figure it out, Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「It's not even worth thinking about」

name: Synn
message: 「......Is that so?」
Without even looking at my face, Azel declared with unusual bluntness.

name: Azel
message: 「It was all just nonsense」
